summary: Flat west kerb among parked cars, but homes within 10-25 m on both sides.

drivers.seclusion: West-side apartments 11 m back at 95 m, then gardens; east-side detached homes 19 m away; no bush or open land.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars on both sides; gaps for a van exist on this kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street linking two cross streets.
drivers.convention: Many cars park along both kerbs, so a van blends in.

flags: Homes 10-25 m away on both sides
Max grade 6% on the line; best section about 1.5%
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb, mostly shaded; sun from the east only after the canopy gap.

best_section.where: West kerb of Lucinda Street just south of the Inverona block, under trees
